text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible! We're going to need a bag,
or it'll be quite a struggle to carry them all home, fufu.
choice_data_list: I guess my experience from my school days came in handy, huh?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Everything is a learning experience after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Since we have this opportunity, it makes me want
to learn how to do it myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In the future, when one of my trainees
wants to collect these—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So that I can do the same thing
for others as Trainer did today.
